procedural_matters: The Race Committee was represented by Coco Stach (Race Committee mark 1).
GER 3139 was represented by Jan-Wessel Gorgs.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident in race 5 of RS Aero 6 were 20 knots of wind and 0.5 meter waves.
GER 3139 as approaching mark 1 for the first time on starboard tack on close-hauled.
When GER 3139 was abeam the mark, she capsized and her sail fell over the mark.
GER 3139 drifted backwards and to leeward of the mark.
After recovering, GER took a 1-turn penalty, runded the mark, and continued sailing.
conclusions: GER 3139 touched mark 1, and broke RRS 31.
By taking a 1-turn penalty, GER 3139 took an appropriate penalty.
